why_this_file_exists: forbade ANY growth of `.secrets.baseline` against a fixed main commit. Its
stated reason is right — an unbounded baseline is a slow-motion wildcard
exclusion — and its implementation could not distinguish 'someone widened
the baseline to hide a secret' from 'a reviewed file legitimately contains
a hex digest'. So it forbade the second in order to forbid the first, and
the first thing anyone hitting it would do is bump the reference commit,
which removes the ratchet entirely and quietly.
Growth is now allowed ONLY for files listed here, only up to the count
recorded here, and only with a reason. Undispositioned growth still fails,
which is the property the ratchet was protecting.

dispositions.what_they_are: sha256 content digests of committed governance documents: part1.md, constitution.md, ratchet-baselines.json, accepted-residuals.json, 03-findings.json, 00-check-catalogue.json, and the generated combined mandate.md
dispositions.classification_rationale: each is recomputable from a file in this repository by `sha256sum`, so nothing is being hidden — the value IS the check. JSON carries no comments, so the in-line `pragma: allowlist secret` this repository uses elsewhere (actionpolicy.py, app/config.py) is not available here.
